description: Web ACL without Sampled Requests on Every Rule
rationale: Sampled requests are the sample of the traffic WAF keeps for the last three hours, with the rule that matched each request. They are what the console shows when a rule has to be understood, and on a web ACL without logging they are the only record of an inspected request that exists anywhere. A rule with sampling disabled cannot be examined at all after the fact: a report that it is blocking a legitimate client can neither be confirmed nor refuted.
remediation: Enable sampled requests in the visibility configuration of the web ACL and of each of its rules
